# Android project for Simon's Solutions
# Generated by Capacitor — do not edit manually unless you know what you're doing.
# Run `npx cap sync android` after any web build to sync assets.

# ─── BUILD INSTRUCTIONS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. Install Android Studio: https://developer.android.com/studio
# 2. Run: npm run build:mobile   (builds Next.js static export)
# 3. Run: npx cap sync android   (copies web assets into android/)
# 4. Open Android Studio: npx cap open android
# 5. Build → Generate Signed Bundle/APK → Android App Bundle (.aab)
#
# ─── SIGNING ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Generate a release keystore (one-time):
#   keytool -genkey -v -keystore release.keystore \
#     -alias simonssolutions \
#     -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000
#
# Store the keystore file OUTSIDE version control.
# Add to android/app/build.gradle signingConfigs block (see PRODUCTION_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md).
